title: Stop re-fetching envelopes for folders that
notes: - Superseded by an owner decision, not by code. Measured on the the production
host mailbox: a `.Logs` folder holds 5,038 messages of which 5,037 fall
inside the 30-day window, so every hourly run bulk-fetches ~5,000 envelopes
and discards them against 1-22 real reports. The envelope fetch is
unavoidable — both the DMARC subject test and the `processed_messages`
de-duplication need it — so the only levers were a folder allow-list or a
result: the owner is moving that log mail to a separate processor, which removes the cost at source. No folder allow-list, no migration, no UI. Reopen only if a mailbox shows the same cost with no way to drain the noisy folder.
resolution: legacy item migrated to format 2 without a recorded resolution
